build_how2_meta_processor: build a How2MetaProcessor to load video IDs from a split file for the HowTo100M dataset
create_sharded_how2_meta_processor: create a ShardedHow2MetaProcessor to map video IDs to their corresponding shard and index
run_sharded_video_processor: run a ShardedVideoProcessor to load mmaped numpy video features from sharded tensor files
test_fixed_len_aligner: test the FixedLenAligner to align video and text features with fixed total sequence length
review_mfmmlm_aligner: review the MFMMLMAligner class to apply masked language model and masked frame model sampling
